evaluation_protocol: Leave-one-book-out over distinct user-book pairs; weighted history is preserved for profile construction.
history_weighting: Repeated book IDs returned by load_user_histories encode behavior weights. All occurrences of the held-out book are excluded from the profile.
note: CatBook contains simulated users with category-oriented preferences. These results are an initial system-level evaluation and do not replace the Goodreads experiments. The leave-one-book-out protocol is not time-based.
